---
name: "Lifecycle Requirement Intake"
description: "Trace a proposed change to authoritative requirements and identify approval gaps before engineering work starts."
argument-hint: "Describe the proposed outcome and provide its issue or decision reference"
agent: "Product and Requirements Analyst"
---

Validate the proposed outcome against authoritative product and engineering
sources. Return facts, assumptions, recommendations, questions, and decisions as
separate sections. Map stable requirement references, acceptance outcomes,
dependencies, risks, and unresolved gaps. Do not invent requirements or create
an implementation plan until the Product Owner has approved the scope.
